phrase.zh: 看清细微的分枝，才能理解更大的结构。
phrase.en: Small branches reveal a larger structure.

visual.zh: 象征性的神经细胞分枝、玻璃片、密闭试剂瓶与放大的镜头组成独立拼贴，呼应戈尔吉的染色观察。细胞图形是原创艺术表达，不是显微照片、解剖图或真实实验记录。
visual.en: An original collage of symbolic nerve-cell branches, glass slides, a closed reagent bottle and a magnified lens evokes Golgi's staining work. The cell motif is artistic, not a micrograph, an anatomical plate or an experimental record.

background.zh:
戈尔吉与卡哈尔共同获得1906年诺贝尔生理学或医学奖，获奖理由是研究神经系统的结构。他发展的银染色方法让神经细胞的细长分枝更容易被观察，而不只是看见细胞主体。配图用分枝与光学器材表现观察的进展，不把艺术化细胞图当作医学资料。
1906年生理学或医学奖；获得本年度奖项的一半。获奖理由（中文译述）：表彰他们对神经系统结构的研究。
background.en:
Golgi shared the 1906 Nobel Prize in Physiology or Medicine with Cajal for work on the structure of the nervous system. His silver-staining method made the fine branches of nerve cells visible, beyond their cell bodies. The artwork interprets this advance through branching forms and optical equipment; its imagined cell is not medical reference material.
1906 — The Nobel Prize in Physiology or Medicine. Received half of the prize. Official motivation: in recognition of their work on the structure of the nervous system
